verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated data-export or account-exit feature. The closest support is that orders placed through your agent can be read in full (via get_order or full-state, UCP-shaped JSON webhooks), and UCP is a published open spec co-developed across the industry. That makes the data format open and the protocol portable to other implementers, but order access is limited to Token-tier agents and webhook setup requires a partner manager. missing for 10: bulk export of all user/agent data, export of profiles, carts and history beyond agent-placed orders, a documented exit or offboarding process, independent corroboration.
